verdict: ROAS strong on paper, but purchases are slipping and need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $4.93 for every $1 spent on $1,493.40 in total spend — a healthy headline number. However, purchases have declined 28.57% week-over-week, and the past three days have seen near-zero buying activity, meaning the strong 28-day ROAS is partly carried by a single high-revenue day in mid-July rather than a consistent purchase cadence. Separately, your Google Business Profile has shown no recorded actions for four consecutive days, which appears to be a data or listing issue rather than a true drop in local interest — that is being investigated and corrected now. On the website, sessions are actually up 10% week-over-week, so traffic is arriving; the priority this week is fixing the subscription funnel so that traffic converts into purchases. New ad creative is also being prepared to address the reach decline on current Instagram content.

watch_item.issue: Purchases have dropped sharply in the last 7 days, and site traffic is not converting — pointing to a funnel breakdown on the subscription page.
watch_item.fix: The subscription page checkout flow is being tested and repaired this period, with full funnel tracking confirmed live by end of August.
